scenario: RARC.5.2.4 — the twin of RARC.5.2.4_ttl_expires_at_its_deadline, one nanosecond short. Blip lives 5 s; the clock advances by 4_999_999_999 ns, so its deadline is still after the engine clock and it must survive the pump: no `fact_retract`. Without this twin the expiry vector would also pass a sweep that retracts early, which is the other half of the boundary. Path: the TTL sweep at clock advance, as in the twin.
rules_ds:
schema Blip scope ttl 5_s:
    id: Int

rule seen:
    Blip b
->
    log info "blip {b.id}"
